import numpy as np

def create_noise_schedule(num_steps, schedule_type='linear'):
    if schedule_type == 'linear':
        beta = np.linspace(0.0001, 0.02, num_steps)
    elif schedule_type == 'cosine':
        t = np.arange(num_steps) / num_steps
        s = 0.008
        f_t = np.cos((t + s) / (1 + s) * np.pi / 2) ** 2
        f_t_minus1 = np.cos((t - 1/num_steps + s) / (1 + s) * np.pi / 2) ** 2
        beta = np.clip(1 - f_t / f_t_minus1, 0, 0.999)
    alpha = 1 - beta
    alpha_bar = np.cumprod(alpha)
    return beta, alpha, alpha_bar
